decisions.decision: Hand T-061 to Claude and build it together with T-234. Sender: the GrowthClub Tantra workspace, with the [email] connected mailbox and the name "Adi test" (testing only). Use this for both lanes and T-234, which closes T-234's workspace question. (1) Extend cloud/src/reminders.ts, which already holds the sealed tantra_key_enc and the tantra_sender setting, with lane routing: create or find the campaigns "RevOps Workshop: Free (/workshop)" and "RevOps Workshop: Paid (/masterclass)", store their IDs in settings, and import each sign-up by intake_submissions.lane, tagged with UTM fields and cohort. (2) Prove it on the simulator first, then send one [email] test sign-up on each lane. (3) In tracker_sync.py, add a Lane Economics tab with registrations, /vip sales, /masterclass seat sales, revenue and cost=0 per weekly cohort. Run it for the 7 to 9 Oct cohort, then deploy and run a pass review. If no Tantra key is sealed, open a separate input task and keep building.

decisions.decision: Do not wait for the mailbox: the lane campaigns are step-less drafts and Tantra does not require a sender to create one. (1) In cloud/src/lane.ts createLaneCampaigns, make the sender optional: if senderId fails, create both drafts without selectedSenderAccountIds (keep the seed list). On later runs, PATCH the sender in once team@growthclub.org is connected. Never use a cold mailbox. Update the vendor-sim and probe-lanes.mjs for the no-sender case. (2) Deploy, then press Create in Cohort Settings, set tantra_lanes=1 and add the two growthcluborg+t061 addresses to tantra_test_emails. (3) Send one 'Adi test' sign-up per lane on live /intake; confirm each lands only in its own campaign (queued_for_launch, a lane_pushes row). Then revoke the test attendees and delete the two test Tantra contacts. (4) Re-run tracker_sync.py, remove the Adi ask from T-061, run the pass review, set review.
